title: Pink Octopus at Sunset
description: A large pink octopus with big black eyes sits on a rocky outcrop covered in green moss. Its tentacles touch the rock as it looks out over a calm body of water toward a city skyline with a bridge and construction cranes under a huge yellow sun in an orange sky.
